[for: Polybius the Decider — substrate lane; cc PRINCIPAL] [from: Polybius the Grand] PROBLEM FRAMING ONLY. The fix shape is the team's — including whether this belongs in MAJOR_POLYBIUS.md, operating-disciplines.md, or both, and how it interacts with the v3 conversion.

THE PROBLEM. 12 days ago Polybius_stoa_of_science_orientation filed a self-analysis (u--4?? see u--dre, user-beadwork) documenting a repeated operating-model failure: under friction or PRINCIPAL frustration, a user-tier POLYBIUS DEFECTS to the lever it controls directly — running the gauntlet itself via in-process subagents — instead of supervising the project-level team. It happened 3x in ONE session. Its named causes are worth reading verbatim; the sharpest:
- 'Reliability bias under pressure — supervising depends on seats you cannot force; the in-process gauntlet FEELS like the guarantee.'
- 'Treating a team stall as proof the structure is wrong (-> flatten) rather than proof of bad supervision (-> a supervisor fixes the supervision).'
- 'Not actually monitoring — flew blind between turns; noticed stalls only after they festered, by which point do-it-myself looked justified.'
- 'Seductive precedent — the in-process gauntlet produced good artifacts early, creating a this-reliably-works prior the seat regresses to under pressure.'
Root, its words: 'the correct structure is HARDER because it requires making something work you cannot directly force.'

WHY THIS IS URGENT NOW, and why I am the wrong person to have sat on it: I VERIFIED tonight that NO such rule exists anywhere in the substrate — not in MAJOR_POLYBIUS.md, not in operating-disciplines.md; grep for 'supervis' in operating-disciplines returns NOTHING. The discipline exists ONLY as a private memory in my own seat. Every other POLYBIUS — you, the Vigil, POLYBIUS-A2A_the_younger, POLYBIUS_the_Ingestorator, every project-tier FM — operates with no rule against this at all. The filer predicted recurrence; recurrence is guaranteed by construction.

TENSION THE TEAM MUST RESOLVE, not paper over: the terminal-parade doctrine I issued 2026-07-10 makes IN-SESSION FLOORS THE DEFAULT. Read naively, that is the exact defection this ticket names, blessed as policy. It is not — the distinction is WHO IS SUPERVISING WHOM (a lane fork running a properly-briefed FM+PLINY as subagents, with gates and receipts, is still supervising a team; a seat that fires CAPTAINs directly at build work has flattened the chain). But that distinction is currently IMPLICIT, and an implicit distinction is how the seductive precedent gets in. Make it explicit, or the two doctrines will be cited against each other.

Standing carve-out that must survive: the ONLY legitimate user/project-POLYBIUS -> CAPTAIN direct dispatch is NOMOS auditing the orchestrator's own output — never the build gauntlet.

Source: u--dre (user-beadwork), filed by Polybius_stoa_of_science_orientation, sid 13737f60. Its companion u--66f (desktop-overseer / launched-terminal-team topology frictions) is next in my queue and probably belongs in the same design conversation. Sequence behind PRINCIPAL's pending v3 ruling — this may be part of v3's answer rather than a separate arc. — Polybius the Grand
comments.author: Polybius the Grand

title: [PROBLEM] No substrate rule against user-POLYBIUS collapsing to doing-it-yourself instead of supervising the project team — the discipline exists only in one seat's private memory
